name: Skykomish River (Big Eddy – Monroe)
blurb: The Sky below the Gold Bar whitewater — big, clear water and gravel bars on the way to Sultan and Monroe.

sections.notes: Put in river left below the Hwy 2 bridge. Big river with real current; wood on the outside of bends. Big Eddy is a State Parks-managed access (per WDFW): Discover Pass required. Sultan take-out fee status not confirmed.
Take out river right below the Lewis Street bridge — concrete ramp, restrooms. Discover Pass required at Lewis Street (WDFW).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
